# Casa Amani

> A 2-bedroom contemporary rental villa in Arco da Calheta, on the quiet south-west coast of Madeira island, Portugal. Built for slow stays — weeks rather than weekends. Equally suited to travellers visiting Madeira and to remote-mobile workers using the island as a base.

## Key facts
- Location: Arco da Calheta, Calheta municipality, Madeira, Portugal
- Bedrooms: 2 (sleeps up to 6 — two king beds plus two single beds on the lower level; the guest bedroom king can split into two singles)
- Bathrooms: 3 (one en-suite to the master, one family bathroom on the main level, one on the lower level)
- House size: 219 m² on a 324 m² plot
- Architecture: split-level contemporary
- Pool: private, heated (optional, extra cost) — 7m long
- Sea view: yes (front-facing, main level)
- Workspace: desk in both bedrooms; external monitor in the guest bedroom; free Wi-Fi throughout the villa and terrace
- Parking: private garage for two cars
- Nearest airport: Madeira International (FNC), 48 km / approx. 50 min by car
- Funchal: approx. 30 min by car
- Nearest bar (Monteiros) and restaurant (Melton's Kitchen): 1 km
- Calheta beach and marina: 6 km / 5 min drive
- Touristic licence (Alojamento Local): 176882/AL
